# Eugene Shemchuk

Eugene Shemchuk is a freelance senior backend/platform engineer based in Amsterdam, Netherlands, specialising in agentic AI systems, backend/platform engineering, and AI product development. 11 years of professional experience. Available for freelance and contract work.

## What he does

- Builds LLM-powered agents and conversational AI systems connected to real APIs, data, and business logic.
- Backend/platform engineering: cloud migrations (AWS, Azure), API design and refactoring, platform reliability.
- Takes AI products from discovery to shipped features, working across engineering, data science, and UX.
- Applied ML across computer vision, NLP-based search, and conversational AI, from data prep to production.

## Problems he solves

- Turning AI prototypes and LLM demos into production-grade software.
- Migrating and modernising backend platforms without breaking service continuity.
- Building conversational/agentic systems that integrate with existing business processes.

## Background

- Lead Platform Engineer, ABN AMRO (2022–present) — cloud migration, LLM-powered components, platform/API work.
- Technical Research Specialist, Netflix (2020–2022) — issue-discovery dashboards, cross-platform investigation, AI automation MVP.
- Data Scientist / Software Engineer, SAI Amsterdam (2018–2020) — retail data platform, conversational AI, computer vision, NLP.
- Earlier: freelance chatbot engineering and R&D/rapid prototyping.

## Selected projects

- Employee virtual assistant cloud migration (AWS to Azure), ABN AMRO.
- Conversational AI system reported to save $1M+ annually, ~30% higher satisfaction (ZEO Alliance).
- Retail data platform and computer-vision pipeline (up to 99.9% accuracy), SAI Amsterdam.
